answer: An embodied agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using interactive physical attestation. Robotic sensors must physically verify the fibrous pile of velvet, measure the electrical impedance of copper, and analyze the spectral absorption of saffron to confirm real-world presence. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital expense of operating dedicated robotic hardware per identity. However, this mechanism excludes purely virtual software agents and remains vulnerable to remote proxy relays.
